description.value: Southern Spice is the first South Indian restaurant in the Fraser Valley, opened in December 2018 by chef and owner Manu George. It specializes in authentic South Indian dishes—dosa, vada, idly, and biryani—drawing on flavors from Madras, Kerala, Mysore, and Hyderabad, with North Indian blends also on offer. The restaurant accommodates food allergies with customized menus and offers catering for private events.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 46m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 80m; wall_loops (4 spaces) at 98m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the restaurant is real and open, operating as the first South Indian restaurant in Fraser Valley. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is confirmed by the website ('We accept reservations and pick up orders'). The website lists many vegetarian dishes (Sambar Vada, Idly, Veg Pakora, Plain Dosa, Gobi Manchurian, Chilly Paneer, etc.), confirming vegetarian options. There is a postcode discrepancy: OSM has V2T 0E5, the website shows V2T 0A5; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Postcode discrepancy: OSM has V2T 0E5, website shows V2T 0A5.
Website lists a second phone number (604-381-5551) not present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible South Indian restaurant in Abbotsford with confirmed takeout, indoor seating, and vegetarian menu options—useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Sambar Vada, Idly, Veg Pakora, Gobi Manchurian, Chilly Paneer, Chilly Gobi, Plain Dosa, Masala Dosa, and several paneer/spinach dosa variants
